facts.business: Max Healthcare Institute Limited operates as a healthcare service provider running hospitals and medical facilities.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The recommended dividend represents a payout ratio of ~27.2% of the standalone profit after tax for the financial year ended March 31, 2026 reflecting the Company's commitment to providing sustainable returns to the Members while retaining adequate resources to fund the Company's growth strategy, capital expenditure requirements and other business needs.

facts.related_party_note: Loan amounting to Rs 11,800 lakhs (March 31, 2025: Rs 9,900 lakhs) given to Muthoot Hospitals Private Limited, for business operations and other capital expenditure purpose, is repayable within 5 years from the date of first disbursement and carries interest rate of 9.25% per annum (March 31, 2025: 9.75% per annum).
